name: Sub-Custody Sleeve Reconstruction
description: Close the structural gap where BD sub-custody sleeve accounts (PCRA Trust, SWTC TTEE, retirement sleeves) carry $35-50M of real silver positions that never appear at gold grain because FIFO replay never receives a Transfer In. Fix: sleeve-scoped ULN (silver/unrealized) opening-lot override before FIFO, scoped by deterministic sleeve detection. Identical pattern to B_01 RPS synthetic lot injection. Phase 0 must pick quantity source from three candidates. DS plan doc: docs/architecture/ADVI_SLEEVE_PLAN.md.
